create table INSUR_EXPORT.病人医嘱详单 as
  (
select a.patient_id || a.visit_id as 唯一就诊标识,
       pmi.inp_no as 住院号,
       a.VISIT_ID as 住院次数,
       pmi.inp_no || a.VISIT_ID as 住院流水号,
       pmi.name as 姓名,
       a.ORDER_NO as 医嘱顺序号,
       (select d.dept_name
          from dept_dict d
         where d.dept_code = a.ORDERING_DEPT) as 开立科室,
       decode(a.repeat_indicator, 0, '临时医嘱', '长期医嘱') 医嘱类别,
       a.START_DATE_TIME as 开立时间,
       a.START_DATE_TIME as 执行时间,
       (select dept_name
          from dept_dict
         where dept_code =
               nvl(nvl(nvl(nvl(nvl((select aa.performed_by
                                     from lab_test_master aa
                                    where aa.test_no = a.app_no),
                                   (select aa.performed_by
                                      from exam_master aa
                                     where aa.exam_no = a.app_no)),
                               (select aa.performed_by
                                  from exam_appoints aa
                                 where aa.exam_no = a.app_no)),
                           (select dispensary
                              from drug_dispense_rec
                             where patient_id = a.patient_id
                               and visit_id = a.visit_id
                               and order_no = a.order_no
                               and rownum = 1)),
                       (select t.dispensary
                          from doct_drug_presc_master t
                         where trunc(t.presc_date) = trunc(a.start_date_time)
                           and t.presc_no = a.current_presc_no
                           and t.patient_id = a.patient_id
                           and t.visit_id = t.visit_id)),
                   a.ordering_dept)) as 执行科室,
       a.STOP_DATE_TIME as 执行结束时间,
       nvl((select mtl_name
             from order_class_dict
            where order_class_code = a.order_class),
           '其他') as 医嘱类型,
       a.order_code as 医嘱编码,
       a.ORDER_TEXT as 医嘱内容,
       a.DOSAGE as 医嘱剂量,
       a.Administration as 医嘱用法,
       a.FREQUENCY as 医嘱频次,
       a.order_code as 组套代码,
       cc.charge_item_code as 收费项目编码
  from orders a
  join pat_master_index pmi
    on pmi.patient_id = a.patient_id
  join (select HIS结算流水号, 病人ID, 住院次数
          from INSUR_EXPORT.信息表
         where 门诊OR住院 = '住院'
           and trunc(结算日期) >= to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
           and trunc(结算日期) < to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
         group by HIS结算流水号, 病人ID, 住院次数) d
    on d.病人id = a.patient_id
   and d.住院次数 = a.VISIT_ID
   and a.order_status in ('2', '3')
  join clinic_vs_charge cc
    on cc.clinic_item_code = a.order_code
)

create table INSUR_EXPORT.药品入库分项汇总表 as
(select s.drug_code 药品编码,
       (select b.drug_name
          from drug_dict b
         where b.drug_code = s.drug_code
           and rownum = 1) 药品名称,
       s.drug_code 医院收费项目编码,
       (select b.drug_name
          from drug_dict b
         where b.drug_code = s.drug_code
           and rownum = 1) 医院收费项目名称,
       s.package_spec 规格,
       s.purchase_price 进价,
       s.package_units 计量单位,
       s.purchase_price * sum(s.quantity) 入库金额,
       sum(s.quantity) 入库数量,
       t.import_date as 入库日期
  FROM DRUG_IMPORT_MASTER T, DRUG_IMPORT_DETAIL S
 where t.document_no = s.document_no
   and exists (select 1
          from drug_storage_dept a
         where t.storage = a.storage_code
           and a.storage_type = '药库')
   and t.import_date >= TO_DATE('?, 'YYYYMMDD')
   AND T.import_date < TO_DATE('?, 'YYYYMMDD')
   and t.account_indicator = 1
 group by s.drug_code, s.package_spec, s.purchase_price, s.package_units, t.import_date)

create table INSUR_EXPORT.药品出库分项汇总表 as
(select s.drug_code 药品编码,
       (select b.drug_name
          from drug_dict b
         where b.drug_code = s.drug_code
           and rownum = 1) 药品名称,
       s.drug_code 医院收费项目编码,
       (select b.drug_name
          from drug_dict b
         where b.drug_code = s.drug_code
           and rownum = 1) 医院收费项目名称,
       T.RECEIVER 领用科室,
       s.package_spec 规格,
       s.purchase_price 出库价格,
       s.package_units 计量单位,
       s.purchase_price * sum(s.quantity) 出库金额,
       sum(s.quantity) 出库数量,
       t.Export_Date 出库日期,
       TO_CHAR(T.EXPORT_DATE, 'YYYY') as 年度
  FROM DRUG_EXPORT_MASTER T, DRUG_EXPORT_DETAIL S
 where t.document_no = s.document_no
   and exists (select 1
          from drug_storage_dept a
         where t.storage = a.storage_code
           and a.storage_type = '药库')
   and t.Export_Date >= TO_DATE('?, 'YYYYMMDD')
   AND T.Export_Date < TO_DATE('?, 'YYYYMMDD')
   and t.account_indicator = 1
 group by s.drug_code,
          s.package_spec,

                                     AND Z.DRUG_SPEC = AA.DRUG_SPEC
                                     AND Z.FIRM_ID = AA.FIRM_ID
                                     AND Z.START_DATE < COMM.F_TODATE('?)))) SUBJ_CODE,
       SUB_STORAGE,
       DRUG_CODE                                                                                编码,
       PACKAGE_SPEC                                                                             包装规格,
       FIRM_ID,
       PACKAGE_UNITS                                                                            包装单位,
       sum(QUANTITY)                                                                            数量,
       PURCHASE_PRICE                                                                           进货价,
       (SELECT TRADE_PRICE
        FROM DRUG_PRICE_LIST AA
        WHERE A.DRUG_CODE = AA.DRUG_CODE
          AND A.PACKAGE_SPEC = AA.DRUG_SPEC
          AND A.FIRM_ID = AA.FIRM_ID
          AND START_DATE = (SELECT max(START_DATE)

                            WHERE Z.DRUG_CODE = AA.DRUG_CODE
                              AND Z.DRUG_SPEC = AA.DRUG_SPEC
                              AND Z.FIRM_ID = AA.FIRM_ID
                              AND Z.START_DATE < COMM.F_TODATE('?)))         销售价
FROM PHARMACY.DRUG_STOCK_LOG_NEW A
WHERE LOG_DATE = COMM.F_TODATE('?)
  AND QUANTITY <> 0
--AND DRUG_CODE = '0706058TA'
GROUP BY SUB_STORAGE, DRUG_CODE, PACKAGE_SPEC, PACKAGE_UNITS, PURCHASE_PRICE, FIRM_ID

SELECT 供货方, 入库库房, 编码, 包装规格, 包装单位, 药品厂家, sum(数量) 数量, 批发价, 零售价, 会计科目
FROM (
         SELECT SUPPLIER                                                                                 供货方,
                SUB_STORAGE                                                                              入库库房,
                DRUG_CODE                                                                                编码,
                PACKAGE_SPEC                                                                             包装规格,
                PACKAGE_UNITS                                                                            包装单位,
                FIRM_ID                                                                                  药品厂家,
                sum(QUANTITY)                                                                            数量,
                (SELECT TRADE_PRICE
                 FROM DRUG_PRICE_LIST AA
                 WHERE DRUG_IMPORT_DETAIL.DRUG_CODE = AA.DRUG_CODE
                   AND DRUG_IMPORT_DETAIL.PACKAGE_SPEC = AA.DRUG_SPEC
                   AND DRUG_IMPORT_DETAIL.FIRM_ID = AA.FIRM_ID
                   AND START_DATE = (SELECT max(START_DATE)
                                     FROM DRUG_PRICE_LIST Z
                                     WHERE Z.DRUG_CODE = AA.DRUG_CODE
                                       AND Z.DRUG_SPEC = AA.DRUG_SPEC
                                       AND Z.FIRM_ID = AA.FIRM_ID
                                       AND Z.START_DATE < ACCT_DATE))                                    零售价,
                TRADE_PRICE                                                                              批发价,
                (SELECT SUBJ_NAME
                 FROM TALLY_SUBJECT_DICT
                 WHERE SUBJ_CODE =
                       (SELECT max(SUBJ_CODE)
                        FROM DRUG_PRICE_LIST AA
                        WHERE DRUG_IMPORT_DETAIL.DRUG_CODE = AA.DRUG_CODE
                          AND DRUG_IMPORT_DETAIL.PACKAGE_SPEC = AA.DRUG_SPEC
                          AND DRUG_IMPORT_DETAIL.FIRM_ID = AA.FIRM_ID
                          AND START_DATE = (SELECT max(START_DATE)
                                            FROM DRUG_PRICE_LIST Z
                                            WHERE Z.DRUG_CODE = AA.DRUG_CODE
                                              AND Z.DRUG_SPEC = AA.DRUG_SPEC
                                              AND Z.FIRM_ID = AA.FIRM_ID
                                              AND Z.START_DATE < COMM.F_TODATE('?)))) 会计科目
         FROM DRUG_IMPORT_MASTER,
              DRUG_IMPORT_DETAIL

GROUP BY 供货方, 入库库房, 编码, 包装规格, 包装单位, 药品厂家, 批发价, 零售价, 会计科目
ORDER BY 供货方, 入库库房

SELECT sum(金额)
FROM (
         SELECT NAME                              姓名,
                (SELECT AA.DEPT_NAME
                 FROM DEPT_DICT AA
                 WHERE AA.DEPT_CODE = ORDERED_BY) 开单科室,
                DRUG_CODE                         代码,
                DRUG_SPEC                         规格,
                UNITS                             单位,
                sum(COSTS)    AS                  单价,
                sum(QUANTITY) AS                  数量,
                sum(PAYMENTS) AS                  金额
         FROM (SELECT NAME,
                      DRUG_CODE,
                      PACKAGE_SPEC || FIRM_ID                   DRUG_SPEC,
                      ORDERED_BY,
                      PACKAGE_UNITS                             UNITS,
                      (DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL.PAYMENTS / QUANTITY)   COSTS,
                      QUANTITY * REPETITION                     QUANTITY, /*数量  剂数 */
                      (DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL.PAYMENTS * REPETITION) PAYMENTS /*实付费用  *剂数*/
               FROM DRUG_PRESC_MASTER,
                    DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL
               WHERE DRUG_PRESC_MASTER.DISPENSING_DATETIME BETWEEN
                   COMM.F_TODATE('?) AND COMM.F_TODATE('?)
                 AND DRUG_PRESC_MASTER.PRESC_DATE = DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL.PRESC_DATE
                 AND DRUG_PRESC_MASTER.PRESC_NO = DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL.PRESC_NO
               UNION ALL
               SELECT NAME,
                      DRUG_CODE,
                      PACKAGE_SPEC || FIRM_ID                        DRUG_SPEC,
                      ORDERED_BY,
                      PACKAGE_UNITS,
                      (DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL_TEMP.PAYMENTS / QUANTITY)   COSTS,
                      QUANTITY * REPETITION                          QUANTITY,
                      (DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL_TEMP.PAYMENTS * REPETITION) PAYMENTS
               FROM DRUG_PRESC_MASTER_TEMP,
                    DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL_TEMP,
                    DEPT_DICT
               WHERE DRUG_PRESC_MASTER_TEMP.PRESC_DATE BETWEEN
                   COMM.F_TODATE('?) AND COMM.F_TODATE('?)
                 AND ORDERED_BY = DEPT_CODE
                 AND DRUG_PRESC_MASTER_TEMP.PRESC_DATE =
                     DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL_TEMP.PRESC_DATE
                 AND DRUG_PRESC_MASTER_TEMP.PRESC_NO =
                     DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL_TEMP.PRESC_NO
               UNION ALL
               SELECT NAME,
                      DRUG_CODE,
                      DRUG_SPEC || FIRM_ID         DRUG_SPEC,
                      ORDERED_BY,
                      DRUG_UNITS,
                      CHARGES / DISPENSE_AMOUNT AS COSTS,
                      DISPENSE_AMOUNT,
                      CHARGES
               FROM DRUG_DISPENSE_REC,
                    PAT_MASTER_INDEX,
                    DEPT_DICT
               WHERE DISPENSING_DATE_TIME BETWEEN COMM.F_TODATE('?) AND COMM.F_TODATE('?)
                 AND ORDERED_BY = DEPT_CODE
                 AND PAT_MASTER_INDEX.PATIENT_ID = DRUG_DISPENSE_REC.PATIENT_ID)
         GROUP BY NAME, ORDERED_BY, DRUG_CODE, DRUG_SPEC, UNITS
         ORDER BY 开单科室)

       DRUG_SPEC 规格,
       UNITS 单位,
       costs as 单价,
       sum(QUANTITY) as 数量,
       sum(PAYMENTS) as 金额
  FROM (SELECT NAME,

               PACKAGE_SPEC || FIRM_ID DRUG_SPEC,

           AND DRUG_PRESC_MASTER.PRESC_NO = DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL.PRESC_NO
        UNION ALL

               DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL_TEMP.PRESC_NO
        UNION ALL
        SELECT NAME,
               DRUG_CODE,
               DRUG_SPEC || FIRM_ID DRUG_SPEC,

create  table  INSUR_EXPORT.病人医嘱详单  as (


select a.patient_id || a.visit_id as 唯一就诊标识,
       pmi.inp_no as 住院号,
       a.VISIT_ID as 住院次数,
    (SELECT zylsh FROM INSURANCE.settle_zy_rec WHERE patient_id = a.patient_id AND visit_id = a.visit_id AND ROWNUM = 1) as     上传医保住院号,
    pmi.id_no 身份证号码,
       pmi.name as 姓名,
       a.patient_id || a.visit_id||a.ORDER_NO|| a.ORDER_SUB_NO as 医嘱顺序号,
       (select d.dept_name
          from dept_dict d
         where d.dept_code = a.ORDERING_DEPT) as 开立科室,
       decode(a.repeat_indicator, 0, '临时医嘱', '长期医嘱') 医嘱类别,
       a.START_DATE_TIME as 开立时间,
       a.START_DATE_TIME as 执行时间,
       (select dept_name
          from dept_dict
         where dept_code =
               nvl(nvl(nvl(nvl(nvl((select aa.performed_by
                                     from lab_test_master aa
                                    where aa.test_no = a.app_no),
                                   (select aa.performed_by
                                      from exam_master aa
                                     where aa.exam_no = a.app_no)),
                               (select aa.performed_by
                                  from exam_appoints aa
                                 where aa.exam_no = a.app_no)),
                           (select dispensary
                              from drug_dispense_rec
                             where patient_id = a.patient_id
                               and visit_id = a.visit_id
                               and order_no = a.order_no
                               and rownum = 1)),
                       (select t.dispensary
                          from doct_drug_presc_master t
                         where trunc(t.presc_date) = trunc(a.start_date_time)
                           and t.presc_no = a.current_presc_no
                           and t.patient_id = a.patient_id
                           and t.visit_id = t.visit_id)),
                   a.ordering_dept)) as 执行科室,
       a.STOP_DATE_TIME as 执行结束时间,
       nvl((select mtl_name
             from order_class_dict
            where order_class_code = a.order_class),
           '其他') as 医嘱类型,
       a.order_code as 医嘱编码,
       a.DOSAGE as 医嘱剂量,
' ' 数量,
       a.Administration as 医嘱用法,
       a.FREQUENCY as 医嘱频次,
              a.ORDER_TEXT as 医嘱内容,
       a.order_code as 组套代码,
       cc.charge_item_code as 收费项目编码
  from orders a
  join pat_master_index pmi
    on pmi.patient_id = a.patient_id
   and a.order_status in ('2', '3')
  join clinic_vs_charge cc
    on cc.clinic_item_code = a.order_code
    where exists (select * from INSUR_EXPORT.病理病人清单 d where d.唯一就诊标识=pmi.patient_id||'-'||a.visit_id))

select
ltm.patient_id 患者ID,
ltm.visit_id 病人序号,
ltm.results_rpt_date_time 报告时间,
ltm.specimen 标本类型,
lti.item_name 项目名称,
lr.report_item_name 项目子项,
lr.units 单位,
lr.result 结果,
lr.result_range 参考范围,
(case lr.abnormal_indicator when 'H' then 'H' when 'N' then 'N' when 'L' then 'L' else 'N' end) 结果状态,
'住院' 患者来源
from lab_test_master ltm, lab_test_items lti, lab_result lr, (select 
v.patient_id,
v.visit_id,
v.discharge_date_time
from pat_visit v, diagnosis d
where v.discharge_date_time  between to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and to_date('?,'yyyymmdd')
and v.patient_id = d.patient_id and v.visit_id = d.visit_id and d.diagnosis_type = '3' and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
and d.diagnosis_desc like '%糖尿病%'
and (select count(1) from pat_visit v1, diagnosis d1 where v1.discharge_date_time  between to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and v1.patient_id = d1.patient_id and v1.visit_id = d1.visit_id and d1.diagnosis_type = '3' and d1.diagnosis_no = '1'
and d1.diagnosis_desc like '%糖尿病%'and v1.patient_id = v.patient_id)  1
and (select count(1) from lab_test_master ltm, lab_result lr, lab_test_items lti where ltm.requested_date_time  between to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and ltm.test_no = lr.test_no and ltm.test_no = lti.test_no
and (lr.report_item_name like '%肾小球滤过率%' or lr.report_item_name like '%肌酐%' or lr.report_item_name like '%尿微量白蛋白%' or lr.report_item_name like '%尿素%') and ltm.patient_id = v.patient_id)  0) a
where ltm.patient_id = a.patient_id and ltm.visit_id = a.visit_id
and ltm.test_no = lti.test_no and ltm.test_no = lr.test_no

em.report_date_time 报告时间,

v.patient_id,
v.visit_id,
v.discharge_date_time

               DRUG_CODE,
               PACKAGE_SPEC || FIRM_ID DRUG_SPEC,

SELECT DISPENSING_DATETIME,
       PATIENT_ID,
       VISIT_ID,
       BED_NO,
       NAME,
       SEX,
       DATE_OF_BIRTH,
       DRUG_NAME,
       DRUG_CODE,
       DRUG_SPEC,
       QUANTITY QUANTITY,
       ORDERED_BY,
       DISPENSING_PROVIDER,
       VERIFY_BY,
       MAILING_ADDRESS,
       DIAGNOSIS,
       ''
                BATCH_NO,
       ''
                EXPIRE_DATE,
       ID_NO,
       PRESC_NO,
       INVENTORY,
       to_char(DISPENSING_DATETIME, 'yyyymmdd') || PRESC_NO
FROM (
         SELECT A.DISPENSING_DATETIME                                               DISPENSING_DATETIME,
                A.PATIENT_ID,
                A.VISIT_ID,
                D.BED_NO,
                E.NAME,
                E.SEX,
                E.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
                F.DRUG_NAME,
                B.DRUG_CODE,
                B.PACKAGE_SPEC || '/' || B.PACKAGE_UNITS || '(' || B.FIRM_ID || ')' DRUG_SPEC,
                B.QUANTITY,
                A.ORDERED_BY,
                A.DISPENSING_PROVIDER,
                A.VERIFY_BY,
                E.MAILING_ADDRESS,
                E.ID_NO,
                A.PRESC_NO,
                B.INVENTORY,
                D.DIAGNOSIS,
                B.YSSM,
                nvl((select name from staff_dict where emp_no = prescribed_by),prescribed_by) prescribed_by
         FROM DRUG_PRESC_MASTER A,
              DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL B,
              PAT_VISIT C,
              PATS_IN_HOSPITAL D,
              PAT_MASTER_INDEX E,
              DRUG_DICT F
         WHERE (A.PRESC_DATE = B.PRESC_DATE AND A.PRESC_NO = B.PRESC_NO)
           AND (A.PATIENT_ID = C.PATIENT_ID(+) AND A.VISIT_ID = C.VISIT_ID(+))
           AND A.PATIENT_ID = D.PATIENT_ID(+)
           AND A.PATIENT_ID = E.PATIENT_ID
           AND (B.DRUG_CODE = F.DRUG_CODE AND B.DRUG_SPEC = F.DRUG_SPEC)
           AND A.DISPENSARY = :as_storage_code
           AND A.PRESC_SOURCE = 1
           AND ((A.DISPENSING_DATETIME >= :adt_start AND A.DISPENSING_DATETIME <= :adt_stop) OR
                (:adt_start IS NULL OR :adt_start < to_date('?, 'yyyy-mm-dd')))
           AND (F.TOXI_PROPERTY = :as_toxin OR :as_toxin = '' OR :as_toxin IS NULL)
           AND (F.DRUG_FORM = :as_form OR :as_form = '' OR :as_form IS NULL)

         UNION ALL

         SELECT A.DISPENSING_DATE_TIME,
                A.PATIENT_ID,
                A.VISIT_ID,
                D.BED_NO,
                E.NAME,
                E.SEX,
                E.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
                F.DRUG_NAME,
                A.DRUG_CODE,
                A.DRUG_SPEC || '/' || A.DRUG_UNITS || '(' || A.FIRM_ID || ')' DRUG_SPEC,
                A.DISPENSE_AMOUNT                                             QUANTITY,
                A.ORDERED_BY,
                A.DISPENSING_PROVIDER,

       FIRM_ID,
       NAME6                                                  供应商,
       sum(H.COSTS) / sum(QUANTITY)                           单价,
       sum(H.QUANTITY)                                        数量,
       sum(H.COSTS)                                           金额
FROM (SELECT A.PRESC_DATE                         PRESC_DATE,
             CASE
                 WHEN nvl(A.VISIT_ID, 0) > 0 THEN
                     '住院'
                 ELSE
                     '门诊'
                 END                              TYPE,
             A.PATIENT_ID,
             (SELECT ID_NO
              FROM PAT_MASTER_INDEX PT
              WHERE PT.PATIENT_ID = A.PATIENT_ID) ID_NO,
             A.NAME,
             (SELECT SEX
              FROM PAT_MASTER_INDEX PT
              WHERE PT.PATIENT_ID = A.PATIENT_ID) SEX,
             B.DRUG_CODE, C.DRUG_NAME, B.PACKAGE_SPEC, B.FIRM_ID, B.PACKAGE_UNITS,
             sum(B.QUANTITY) * A.REPETITION       QUANTITY,
             sum(B.COSTS) * A.REPETITION          COSTS
      FROM DRUG_PRESC_DETAIL B, DRUG_PRESC_MASTER A, DRUG_PRICE_LIST D, DRUG_NAME_DICT C
      WHERE A.PRESC_DATE = B.PRESC_DATE
        AND A.PRESC_NO = B.PRESC_NO
        AND C.DRUG_CODE = D.DRUG_CODE
        AND C.STD_INDICATOR = 1
        AND B.DRUG_CODE = D.DRUG_CODE
        AND B.PACKAGE_SPEC = D.DRUG_SPEC
        AND B.FIRM_ID = D.FIRM_ID
        AND (B.DRUG_CODE, B.PACKAGE_SPEC) IN (SELECT CODE, NAME FROM SFG_DATA)
        AND A.DISPENSING_DATETIME BETWEEN F_TODATE('?) AND F_TODATE('?)
        AND D.START_DATE <= A.DISPENSING_DATETIME
        AND (A.DISPENSING_DATETIME < D.STOP_DATE OR D.STOP_DATE IS NULL)
      GROUP BY B.DRUG_CODE, C.DRUG_NAME, B.PACKAGE_SPEC, B.PACKAGE_UNITS, D.TRADE_PRICE, A.REPETITION, A.PRESC_DATE,
               A.PATIENT_ID, A.NAME, CASE WHEN nvl(A.VISIT_ID, 0) > 0 THEN '住院' ELSE '门诊' END, B.FIRM_ID
      UNION ALL
      SELECT DISPENSING_DATE_TIME,

       sum(H.TRADE_PRICE)                                                         TRADE_PRICE
FROM (
         SELECT B.DRUG_CODE, C.DRUG_NAME, B.PACKAGE_SPEC, B.PACKAGE_UNITS, sum(B.QUANTITY) * A.REPETITION QUANTITY,
                sum(B.COSTS) * A.REPETITION                                                               COSTS,

           AND B.DRUG_CODE = D.DRUG_CODE
           AND B.PACKAGE_SPEC = D.DRUG_SPEC
           AND B.FIRM_ID = D.FIRM_ID
           AND A.DISPENSING_DATETIME BETWEEN F_TODATE('?) AND F_TODATE('?)
           AND D.START_DATE <= A.DISPENSING_DATETIME
           AND (A.DISPENSING_DATETIME < D.STOP_DATE OR D.STOP_DATE IS NULL)
         GROUP BY B.DRUG_CODE, C.DRUG_NAME, B.PACKAGE_SPEC, B.PACKAGE_UNITS, D.TRADE_PRICE, A.REPETITION

         SELECT E.DRUG_CODE, G.DRUG_NAME, E.DRUG_SPEC, E.DRUG_UNITS, sum(E.DISPENSE_AMOUNT) DISPENSE_AMOUNT,

         GROUP BY E.DRUG_CODE, G.DRUG_NAME, E.DRUG_SPEC, E.DRUG_UNITS, F.TRADE_PRICE) H

  when '9' then '其他' ELSE nvl((select treating_result_dict.treating_result_name from treating_result_dict where treating_result_dict.treating_result_code = d.treat_result),d.treat_result) end  治愈状态,
d.diagnosis_desc 疾病名称
from diagnosis d, (select 
v.patient_id,
v.visit_id,
v.discharge_date_time
from pat_visit v, diagnosis d
where v.discharge_date_time  between to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and to_date('?,'yyyymmdd')
and v.patient_id = d.patient_id and v.visit_id = d.visit_id and d.diagnosis_type = '3' and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
and d.diagnosis_desc like '%糖尿病%'
and (select count(1) from pat_visit v1, diagnosis d1 where v1.discharge_date_time  between to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and v1.patient_id = d1.patient_id and v1.visit_id = d1.visit_id and d1.diagnosis_type = '3' and d1.diagnosis_no = '1'
and d1.diagnosis_desc like '%糖尿病%'and v1.patient_id = v.patient_id) > 1
and (select count(1) from lab_test_master ltm, lab_result lr, lab_test_items lti where ltm.requested_date_time  between to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and ltm.test_no = lr.test_no and ltm.test_no = lti.test_no
and (lr.report_item_name like '%肾小球滤过率%' or lr.report_item_name like '%肌酐%' or lr.report_item_name like '%尿微量白蛋白%' or lr.report_item_name like '%尿素%') and ltm.patient_id = v.patient_id) > 0) a
where d.patient_id = a.patient_id and d.visit_id = a.visit_id

select
ltm.patient_id 患者ID,
a.visit_no 病人序号,
ltm.results_rpt_date_time 报告时间,
ltm.specimen 标本类型,
lti.item_name 项目名称,
lr.report_item_name 项目子项,
lr.units 单位,
lr.result 结果,
lr.result_range 参考范围,
(case lr.abnormal_indicator when 'H' then 'H' when 'N' then 'N' when 'L' then 'L' else 'N' end) 结果状态,
'门诊' 患者来源
from lab_test_master ltm, lab_test_items lti, lab_result lr, outp_treat_rec otr, (select om.patient_id, om.visit_date, om.visit_no
from outp_mr om
where om.visit_date  between to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and to_date('?,'yyyymmdd')
and om.diag_desc like '%糖尿病%'
and (select count(1) from outp_mr om1 where om1.visit_date  between to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and om1.diag_desc like '%糖尿病%'and om1.patient_id = om.patient_id) > 1
and (select count(1) from lab_test_master ltm, lab_result lr, lab_test_items lti where ltm.requested_date_time  between to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and ltm.test_no = lr.test_no and ltm.test_no = lti.test_no
and (lr.report_item_name like '%肾小球滤过率%' or lr.report_item_name like '%肌酐%' or lr.report_item_name like '%尿微量白蛋白%' or lr.report_item_name like '%尿素%') and ltm.patient_id = om.patient_id) > 0) a
where --otr.patient_id = a.patient_id and 
otr.visit_date = a.visit_date and otr.visit_no = a.visit_no and otr.appoint_no = ltm.test_no
and ltm.test_no = lti.test_no and ltm.test_no = lr.test_no

select
em.patient_id 患者ID,
em.exam_no 报告单编号,
a.visit_no 病人序号,
(select o.ORDER_NO from orders o where o.patient_id = em.patient_id and o.visit_id = em.visit_id and o.app_no = em.exam_no and o.order_sub_no = 1 and rownum = 1) 医嘱序号,

and (select count(1) from outp_mr om1 where om1.visit_date  between to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and to_date('?,'yyyymmdd') and om1.diag_desc like '%糖尿病%'and om1.patient_id = om.patient_id) > 1

and (lr.report_item_name like '%肾小球滤过率%' or lr.report_item_name like '%肌酐%' or lr.report_item_name like '%尿微量白蛋白%' or lr.report_item_name like '%尿素%') and ltm.patient_id = om.patient_id) > 0) a
where --otr.patient_id = a.patient_id and 
otr.visit_date = a.visit_date and otr.visit_no = a.visit_no and otr.appoint_no = em.exam_no
